snippet.title: Lt.Ahmed Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description: Lieutenant Ahmed (Lt. Ahmed) is stealth casual action game developed by Six Path Studios tells a story about a one man army character tasked with gathering intel, and clearing an island of terrorists and pirates alike.
